_note: Human decisions about SNOMED bindings. Applied AFTER every binder run by scripts/apply_corrections.py, so improving the binder never discards a review. Without this the 348-candidate queue resets each time the binder changes.

_states.corrected_pending_attestation: a human chose this concept; awaiting named sign-off
_states.attested: signed off by a named clinician; carries attestor and date
_states.rejected: this condition must NOT bind to this concept

corrections.condition: Pre-exposure prophylaxis against human immunodeficiency virus infection
corrections.display: Antiretroviral pre-exposure prophylaxis for HIV infection

corrected_from.why_wrong: Inverts the clinical situation. PrEP is given to people WITHOUT HIV; this concept asserts established infection, in pregnancy.

corrections.why: PBS wording names an intervention. 918591000168102 is an Australian extension concept (namespace 1000168) under 897017002 Antiviral prophylaxis. The binder leaves it a candidate because the PBS phrasing 'against human immunodeficiency virus infection' is not an exact match for 'for HIV infection' — a judgement call, so it is recorded here rather than auto-bound.
